_source: THE source for fumble content. data/fumbles.json is generated from this file by tools/fumbles-to-tables.mjs and must not be hand-edited.
_tags: `attackTypes` selects which of the six fumble tables an entry can appear in. There is no rank: the twenty rows of a fumble table are unordered peers, so the die picks flavour rather than severity. `faces` (default 1) gives an entry several faces of every table it is on.
_content: An entry is COMPLETE with `id` and `name`. `text` is its prose (HTML, enriched on the card, PF1 enrichers work in it), `note` the terse GM line. Mechanics: `buffs` (buff names), `conditions` (same shape as data/pool.json), `damage`, `save` as { type: fort|ref|will, dc } with `onFail` for the failed branch, and `special` for the automated outcomes (reattack, selfDamage, weaponDamage, weaponBroken, weaponStuck). `recipient: defender` sends the buffs and conditions to the attack's target instead of the fumbler; `buffTarget` points a delivered buff's roll-bonuses target at the fumbler's token or the fumbling attack.

entries.name: Lucky Miss
entries.text: It goes badly wrong, and somehow nothing comes of it.

entries.name: Prone
entries.text: Your footing goes out from under you and you hit the ground.

entries.name: Off Balance
entries.text: The miss pulls you off your stance, and you are slow to recover it.

entries.name: Overextended
entries.text: You commit everything to the attack and have nothing left. You lose the rest of this turn's attacks, and cannot make attacks of opportunity until your next turn.

entries.name: Reeling Attack
entries.text: The attack leaves you reeling.

entries.name: Stumble
entries.text: You stumble into a random open adjacent square. The movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

entries.name: Ally Struck
entries.text: The attack carries on into a friend. Make a fresh attack against a random ally within reach, or in the line of fire. If there is none, nothing comes of it.

entries.name: Wrong Target
entries.text: The attack finds someone else entirely. Make a fresh attack against a random different creature within reach, or in the line of fire, friend or foe.

entries.name: Damage Self
entries.text: The attack comes back on you. You take its damage as nonlethal damage.

entries.name: Opened Defenses
entries.text: The miss leaves you wide open. The creature you attacked may make an attack of opportunity against you.

entries.name: Dropped Defenses
entries.text: Your guard drops completely. Every enemy threatening you may make an attack of opportunity against you.

entries.name: Weapon Dropped
entries.text: Your grip fails and the weapon falls at your feet.
entries.note: Weak on the thrown table: the weapon was leaving the hand anyway. To be replaced there.

entries.name: Flung Weapon
entries.text: The weapon flies out of your hand and lands 1d4 squares away in a random direction.
entries.note: Weak on the thrown table: the weapon was leaving the hand anyway. To be replaced there.

entries.name: Weapon Broken
entries.text: Something gives with a crack. The weapon is broken.
entries.note: Weak on the thrown table unless the weapon is magic or returning. To be replaced there.

entries.name: Weapon Takes Damage
entries.text: The full force of the attack goes into your own weapon. It takes the attack's damage, less its hardness.

entries.name: Weapon Stuck
entries.text: The weapon bites into something nearby and sticks there: the floor, a wall, a beam, the target's armor or shield.

entries.name: Riposte
entries.text: Your opponent sees the opening. They may make a free disarm attempt against you, with no penalty if it fails. On a success, they may take the weapon if they have a hand free.

entries.name: Horrific Facial Scar
entries.text: The weapon comes back and opens your face. It will heal into something memorable.

entries.name: Slipped String
entries.text: The string slips its notch. Restringing the weapon takes a full-round action.

entries.name: Snapped String
entries.text: The string snaps. The weapon is useless until the string is replaced.

entries.name: String Slap
entries.text: The string whips across your forearm and face.

entries.name: Jammed Mechanism
entries.text: The mechanism catches. Your next reload takes an extra move action.

entries.name: Spilled Quiver
entries.text: Your ammunition spills across the ground. Gathering it back up takes a move action.

entries.name: Strained Shoulder
entries.text: Something in your shoulder tears. It lasts until it is healed, or until a successful DC 15 Heal check treats it.

entries.name: Like Hitting a Wall
entries.text: You hit something much harder than you meant to. You take the attack's minimum damage as nonlethal damage.

entries.name: Caught Attack
entries.text: Your opponent catches the limb as it comes in. They may make a free grapple attempt against you.

entries.name: Tangled Up
entries.text: Your own limbs get in each other's way.

entries.name: Bruising Attack
entries.text: The blow lands on you harder than on anything else. That natural attack is bruised and weaker for a while.

entries.name: Demoralizing Attack
entries.text: That went badly enough to shake your confidence.

entries.name: Telegraphed Moves
entries.text: Your opponent has read your style. They gain a bonus on attacks against you for the rest of the fight.

entries.name: Weapon Snag
entries.text: The next weapon catches as you reach for it. You lose the rest of this turn's attacks.

entries.name: Overcommitted Throw
entries.text: You put your whole body into the throw and keep going.

entries.name: Grit in the Eyes
entries.text: Dust, sweat or grit gets into your eyes. A move action clears them early.

entries.name: Winded
entries.text: The effort takes the wind out of you. A short rest clears it.
